sn5.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sā vatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn5.1:1.3: Atha kho Āḷavikā bhikkhunī pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi ||
sn5.1:1.4: Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ ten-upasaṅkami vivekatthikinī || || 3.
sn5.1:1.5: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Āḷavikāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattam lomahaṃsam uppādetu-kāmo vivekamhā cāvetu-kāmo yena Āḷavikā bhikkhunī ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Āḷavikam bhikkhuṇim gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn5.1:3.1: Atha kho Āḷavikāyā bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi || ||
sn5.1:3.2: Ko nu khvāyam manusso vā amanusso vā gāthaṃ bhāsatīti || || 5.
sn5.1:3.3: Atha kho Āḷavikāya bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi || ||
sn5.1:3.4: Māro kho ayaṃ pāpimā mama bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo vivekamhā cāvetu-kāmo gāthaṃ bhāsatīti || || 6.
sn5.1:3.5: Atha kho Āḷavikā bhikkhunī Māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā Māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya paccabhāsi || ||
sn5.1:6.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ Āḷavikā bhikkhunī ti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānam || ||
